knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Incompatible products can react and release toxic gas, so they are separated. The handbook and the textbook both stress this.
The textbook warns that extra care is needed for baby pools, and the dose must follow the plan.
The safety data sheet and label give the hazards and the protective requirements, and they come before any handling.

practicalCriteria: Safety data sheet is read and referred to before any product is handled, with the named protective equipment worn
Incompatible products are observed to be stored apart and not mixed
Small-pool treatment is carried out only on the plan's basis, with children kept away and the dose recorded
Storage is observed locked, ventilated and away from the filter
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Product use record for one supervised treatment
stopWorkCriteria: Incompatible products stored together or mixed
Product handled without its safety data sheet read
Child in the immediate area during chemical treatment
Small pool dosed at the full-size dose without the plan's authority
